Form with hierarchical field names (address.street), a radio group with appearance states, read-only, required, comb and calculated fields. Stirling-PDF scale-pages, crop, booklet, split-by-sections and repair drop every field; form fill stores a value longer than MaxLen.

JavaScript in eight places: OpenAction with a Next chain, the name tree, catalog and page AA, a link, a field keystroke, an annotation and a stream-valued JS. Stirling-PDF sanitize leaves three of the scripts (the OpenAction Next chain, the link and the square annotation's AA); show-javascript lists only the name-tree script.

Four pages linked by explicit, named (name tree and old Dests dict), URI and GoToR destinations, with bookmarks and page labels. Stirling-PDF merge rewrites bookmark targets as bare page numbers; remove-pages drops the App- page label; scale-pages and n-up drop the links.
Bookmarks four levels deep with UTF-16 and emoji titles, closed branches, colour and style flags, an item with no target and one aimed at a missing object

Eleven annotation types, each with an appearance stream: highlight, ink, square, circle, line with arrows, polygon, stamp, sticky note with popup, free text, underline, caret. Stirling-PDF scale-pages, n-up, booklet and split-by-sections drop all of them; crop and repair drop some.
Signature field whose ByteRange is correct but whose Contents is a few bytes of junk DER, not a real PKCS#7 signature

Attachments with a UTF-16 name, wrong declared size, a file spec with no embedded stream, and a file-attachment annotation on the page. Stirling-PDF sanitize with embedded-file removal keeps the annotation's file and the file listed in /AF.
Seven pages with mixed page labels: roman, arabic, a prefixed range, letters starting at AA, and a prefix-only label
300 small pages in a balanced page tree of 50-page nodes; stacking them on one page passes the 14,400-unit page size limit. Stirling-PDF pdf-to-single-page turns it into one 612 x 237,600 point page.
Six page sizes in one file: A4, landscape Letter, a business card, A0, a Letter page with Rotate 90 and an offset MediaBox with a CropBox

Tagged two-column page whose content stream draws the right column first; the structure tree gives the true order, plus a figure with no Alt and a table. Stirling-PDF PDF to text and HTML follow the content order; PDF to Markdown interleaves the two columns line by line; repair drops the structure tree.
Info dictionary with an impossible date, a date in words, an emoji title, PDFDocEncoding bytes, a name and a number where strings belong, and an array value
XMP that is not well-formed XML (unclosed element, undeclared prefix) and claims PDF/A-2B, next to a valid Info dictionary
Well-formed XMP whose title, author and dates disagree with the Info dictionary. Stirling-PDF update-metadata changes the Info dictionary but leaves the old XMP title and author.
Page transparency group, constant alpha, Multiply blend, a luminosity soft mask and a knockout group
Separation spot colour and DeviceN through PostScript calculator (Type 4) functions, Lab, CalRGB and Indexed colour spaces
Axial, radial and function-based shadings painted with sh and as patterns, coloured and uncoloured tiling patterns, and text filled with a pattern

Optional content: a layer hidden by default holding the word SECRET, a print-only layer, a locked layer, an OCMD visibility expression and a hidden annotation. Stirling-PDF PDF to text and Markdown include the hidden and print-only text; auto-redact leaves SECRET in the hidden annotation's Contents.
A page of vector drawing only (bar chart and a hand-drawn signature stroke), with no text and no images: blank-page detection must render it. Stirling-PDF remove-blanks classes it as blank.
Two font resources with the same BaseFont but different encodings, plus an exact duplicate: only the duplicate may be merged

Page whose only words live in annotations and form fields (free text, a stamp, a filled field): text tools and blank detection must look there too. Stirling-PDF auto-redact leaves Invoice readable in the annotation; remove-blanks deletes the page as blank.

Arabic stored in visual order, once with a ToUnicode that maps to presentation forms (U+FExx) and once mapped to base letters. Stirling-PDF auto-redact of the first Arabic word fails with a 500 (redaction could not be verified).
fi and fl ligature glyphs whose ToUnicode maps one code to two letters, so search and redaction must match 'office' and 'flow' across a ligature
